description: Baserow is an open-source, no-code database with a spreadsheet-style interface. It supports views, forms, automations, an API, and an AI assistant, and can be used in the cloud or self-hosted.
name: Baserow
subtitle: Open-source no-code database and Airtable alternative

description: Ben's Bites is an AI newsletter started by Ben Tossell. It covers product launches, tools, funding, and news with a personal voice, and has grown into a community with a paid tier and job board.
name: Ben's Bites
subtitle: AI newsletter by Ben Tossell

description: Better Stack combines uptime monitoring, log management, incident management and on-call scheduling, and status pages in one product. Smaller engineering teams use it to replace several separate tools.
name: Better Stack
subtitle: Uptime monitoring, log management, and incident alerts

description: BigQuery is Google Cloud's serverless data warehouse. You query very large datasets with SQL, build machine learning models in SQL with BigQuery ML, and get help writing queries from Gemini.
name: BigQuery
subtitle: Google Cloud's serverless data warehouse

description: Blackbaud provides software for nonprofits, schools, and healthcare organizations, including fundraising, donor management, accounting, and grants. Raiser's Edge NXT is its flagship donor database, and AI features help identify prospects and write content.
name: Blackbaud
subtitle: Fundraising and donor management software for nonprofits

description: Bland builds AI phone agents for enterprises that take and place calls for support, sales, and appointment setting. Developers design call flows with Conversational Pathways, and the agent can transfer to a human when needed.
name: Bland AI
subtitle: AI phone agents for inbound and outbound calls

description: Blender is a free, open-source 3D creation suite. It covers modeling, sculpting, animation, rendering, simulation, and video editing, and a large add-on ecosystem includes AI tools for texturing and generation.
name: Blender
subtitle: Free open-source 3D creation suite

description: The Bloomberg Terminal is a subscription desktop platform for finance professionals. It combines live market data, news, analytics, trading tools, and messaging, with AI features for searching documents and summarizing earnings calls and news.
name: Bloomberg Terminal
subtitle: Market data and news terminal for finance professionals

description: Boomi is an integration and automation platform with low-code tools for connecting apps, data, and APIs. It adds AI agents and governance features, and companies use it to link systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and Workday.
name: Boomi
subtitle: Integration and automation platform with AI agents

description: Box AI adds question answering, summaries, and data extraction to documents in Box. It works within existing permissions, supports multiple AI models, and offers agents for processing contracts, forms, and other content.
name: Box AI
subtitle: AI questions, summaries, and data extraction for files stored in Box

description: Brainly is a student community and learning app where learners ask homework questions and get answers from peers, experts, and an AI tutor. It covers school subjects across many countries and languages.
name: Brainly
subtitle: Student homework help community with an AI tutor

description: Bria offers text-to-image and image-editing models trained only on licensed content, sold through an API to businesses worried about copyright. Content owners whose work is in the training set receive payment.
name: Bria
subtitle: Image generation models trained on licensed data

description: BrightEdge is an enterprise SEO and content performance platform. It tracks keyword rankings, analyzes content, finds opportunities, and now measures visibility in AI search answers, mostly for large sites.
name: BrightEdge
subtitle: Enterprise SEO and content performance platform

description: Browzwear makes VStitcher and related software for 3D garment design. Apparel brands simulate fabrics, fit, and drape on digital avatars to approve designs before sewing physical samples.
name: Browzwear
subtitle: 3D fashion design software

description: Bruno is an open-source API client for testing and documenting APIs. It stores collections as plain text files on your disk, so they sit in git with the code, and it works offline without a cloud account.
name: Bruno
subtitle: Open-source API client that keeps collections as plain files

description: Builder.io is a visual development platform and headless CMS. It lets marketers edit pages built in frameworks like React and Vue, and uses AI to convert designs into code and to generate apps.
name: Builder.io
subtitle: Visual CMS and Figma-to-code tool

description: Buildium is property management software for small and mid-sized rental portfolios. It handles listings, applications, leasing, rent collection, maintenance requests, and accounting. RealPage owns it.
name: Buildium
subtitle: Property management software for small landlords

description: Bumble is a dating app where, in matches between men and women, women send the first message. It also has modes for making friends and professional networking, and uses AI to flag fake profiles and inappropriate content.
name: Bumble
subtitle: Dating app where women make the first move

description: BuzzSumo is a content research tool that shows which articles get the most shares and links for a topic, who shared them, and which influencers cover it. Marketers use it to plan content and monitor competitors.
name: BuzzSumo
subtitle: Content research and influencer discovery tool

description: Capture One is a RAW photo editor and tethered capture tool used by studio and commercial photographers. It's known for color control and tethering, with layers, AI masking, and a mobile app.
name: Capture One
subtitle: Professional RAW photo editor with tethered shooting

description: CARTO is a location intelligence platform that runs spatial analysis directly inside cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks. It offers map builders, workflows, and AI agents for spatial questions.
name: CARTO
subtitle: Cloud-native location intelligence platform

description: Cartoon Animator from Reallusion rigs 2D characters from images and animates them with a webcam, preset motions, or lip sync from audio. It is used for explainer videos, YouTube content, and small-studio animation.
name: Cartoon Animator
subtitle: Reallusion's 2D character animation software

description: Cavalry is a motion design application built around procedural animation. Behaviors, generators, and connections drive shapes, so designers create complex loops and graphics without setting every keyframe by hand.
name: Cavalry
subtitle: Procedural 2D animation and motion design app

description: CertiK is a blockchain security company that audits smart contracts, monitors on-chain activity, and provides tools for finding exploits. Crypto projects hire it before launch and use its monitoring after.
name: CertiK
subtitle: Blockchain security audits and monitoring

description: Chainalysis provides blockchain analysis software that traces cryptocurrency transactions. Exchanges, banks, and government agencies use it for compliance, investigations, and fraud detection.
name: Chainalysis
subtitle: Blockchain analysis for compliance and investigations

description: Cinema 4D is Maxon's 3D modeling, animation, and rendering software, popular with motion designers and visual effects artists. It's known for an approachable interface and tight integration with After Effects and other tools.
name: Cinema 4D
subtitle: Maxon's 3D software popular for motion graphics

description: Claude Cowork is a desktop agent for people who do not write code. You give it a task and access to a folder, and it works through files, documents, and spreadsheets on your computer while you do something else.
name: Claude Cowork
subtitle: Claude agent for file and task automation without the terminal

description: Claude Design is Anthropic's tool for creating visual work by conversation. You describe slides, mockups, or prototypes, and Claude builds them, then you refine the result with follow-up requests.
name: Claude Design
subtitle: Anthropic Labs tool for creating visuals and prototypes with Claude

description: ClickCease monitors paid ad traffic for fake and repeated clicks and blocks the sources automatically. Advertisers use it to stop wasted spend from bots and competitors. CHEQ owns it.
name: ClickCease
subtitle: Click fraud protection for Google and Meta ads

description: Clio is cloud software for law firms covering case management, time tracking, billing, client intake, and payments. Clio Duo is its AI assistant, and the company has expanded into legal research and drafting.
name: Clio
subtitle: Practice management software for law firms

description: Clipchamp is a video editor from Microsoft that runs in the browser and is built into Windows 11. It offers templates, stock media, automatic captions, screen recording, and AI features such as a tool that assembles a draft from your clips.
name: Clipchamp
subtitle: Microsoft's browser-based video editor

description: CoachHub gives employees access to certified coaches by video, plus an AI coach called AIMY for everyday conversations between sessions. Companies buy it as a development benefit.
name: CoachHub
subtitle: Digital coaching platform for employers with an AI coach

description: Codacy performs automated code quality and security checks on every commit and pull request. It reports issues, test coverage, and duplication in the Git workflow, so teams can enforce shared standards.
name: Codacy
subtitle: Automated code quality and security checks on every pull request

description: Constant Contact is an email and digital marketing platform for small businesses and nonprofits. It offers templates, automation, SMS, event tools, and an AI content generator to draft emails and campaigns.
name: Constant Contact
subtitle: Email marketing for small businesses

description: Coolors is a color palette generator and tool for designers. Press the spacebar to generate a palette, lock colors you like, and adjust the rest, then export to design tools. It also has an AI palette generator, image color picker, and contrast checker.
name: Coolors
subtitle: Color palette generator for designers

description: Cornerstone OnDemand sells learning management, talent management, and skills tools to large organizations. It uses AI to recommend training based on roles and skills, and to build learning paths.
name: Cornerstone OnDemand
subtitle: Talent and learning management suite for large employers

description: Course Hero hosts study guides, notes, and course materials shared by students and offers tutor Q&A. Its AI assistant helps with homework questions, and access to most documents requires an account or subscription.
name: Course Hero
subtitle: Study guides, tutors, and AI homework help

description: Creatopy is a design and automation tool for banner ads and social creatives. It resizes one design across many formats, adds animation, and publishes finished ads to Google, Meta, and other ad platforms.
name: Creatopy
subtitle: Ad design and animation platform with AI generation

description: Cresta is an AI platform for contact centers. It listens to live calls and suggests what agents should say, scores conversations for coaching, and offers AI agents that handle calls on their own.
name: Cresta
subtitle: Real-time coaching and AI agents for contact centers

description: Crusoe is a cloud and AI infrastructure company. It rents GPU clusters for training and inference and builds large data centers, and it began by using stranded natural gas for computing.
name: Crusoe
subtitle: GPU cloud and AI data centers

description: Cvent is an event management platform for planning conferences, meetings, and large events. It covers registration, venue sourcing, attendee engagement, and analytics, and is used by corporations, associations, and agencies.
name: Cvent
subtitle: Event management, registration, and venue sourcing platform

description: Agent Bricks is Databricks' toolkit for building, evaluating, and tuning AI agents on a company's own governed data. It works alongside Lakebase, Databricks' Postgres database for agent workloads, and the Databricks lakehouse.
name: Databricks Agent Bricks
subtitle: Databricks product for building and evaluating AI agents on company data

description: DataCamp teaches data skills through short video lessons and coding exercises that run in the browser. Courses cover Python, R, SQL, statistics, machine learning, and AI, with career tracks, projects, and certifications.
name: DataCamp
subtitle: Interactive courses for data science, SQL, and AI

description: DaVinci Resolve is Blackmagic Design's video editor with built-in color grading, visual effects, motion graphics, and audio post-production. A capable free version exists, and the paid Studio version adds more AI-powered tools.
name: DaVinci Resolve
subtitle: Video editor with industry-standard color grading

description: Daytona provides isolated environments where AI agents can run code. They start up in a fraction of a second and are thrown away afterward. The project began as an open-source tool for development environments.
name: Daytona
subtitle: Secure sandboxes for running AI-generated code

description: Decagon sells AI support agents that resolve customer tickets across chat, email, and voice. Support teams define behavior in plain language through rules, and the agent hands off to a human when it cannot finish.
name: Decagon
subtitle: AI customer support agents for chat, email, and voice

description: Deepnote is a collaborative cloud notebook for Python, SQL, and R. Teams connect to their warehouse, work together in real time, publish results as apps, and use an AI agent that writes and fixes code in the notebook.
name: Deepnote
subtitle: Collaborative data notebook with an AI agent

description: DeepScribe records the conversation in the exam room and drafts the visit note for the clinician to review. It began in oncology and now covers a range of outpatient specialties.
name: DeepScribe
subtitle: AI medical scribe that writes notes during patient visits

description: Deputy builds shift schedules, tracks time and attendance, and handles shift swaps and payroll exports for hourly workers. Restaurants, retailers, and care providers use it to manage labor costs and compliance.
name: Deputy
subtitle: Shift scheduling and time tracking for hourly teams

description: Dia is an AI browser from The Browser Company, makers of Arc. You can chat with your tabs, ask questions about open pages, and use the address bar as a prompt box. Atlassian acquired the company.
name: Dia
subtitle: AI browser from The Browser Company

description: Digital Diagnostics makes LumineticsCore, formerly IDx-DR, an FDA-authorized system that reads retinal images for diabetic retinopathy without a specialist reviewing them. Primary care clinics use it to screen patients on site.
name: Digital Diagnostics
subtitle: Autonomous AI diabetic eye exam

description: DISCO is a cloud platform for e-discovery and document review in litigation. It uses AI to prioritize documents, summarize evidence, and speed up review, and competes with Relativity and Everlaw.
name: DISCO
subtitle: Cloud e-discovery platform for legal teams

description: Dotmatics provides software for scientific data, electronic lab notebooks, and R&D workflows in biotech and pharma. It is part of Siemens and includes products such as SnapGene, GraphPad Prism, and Geneious.
name: Dotmatics
subtitle: Life sciences R&D software, now part of Siemens

description: Dropbox Sign, formerly HelloSign, is an electronic signature service for sending, signing, and tracking documents. It integrates with Dropbox, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365, and offers an API for embedding signing in other apps.
name: Dropbox Sign
subtitle: E-signature service formerly known as HelloSign

description: DxO PhotoLab is a RAW photo editor known for lens and camera corrections and its DeepPRIME XD denoising. It offers local adjustments, automatic optical fixes, and a one-time purchase license.
name: DxO PhotoLab
subtitle: RAW editor known for lens correction and DeepPRIME denoising

description: Dynatrace is an observability and application security platform for large enterprises. Its OneAgent collects data automatically, and its Davis AI engine uses causal analysis to trace problems to their root cause.
name: Dynatrace
subtitle: Observability platform with AI-driven root cause analysis

description: Easy With AI is a directory of AI tools sorted by category. Each listing links out to the tool's own site.
name: Easy With AI
subtitle: Directory of AI tools sorted by category

description: Elasticsearch is an open-source search and analytics engine. It handles full-text, vector, and hybrid search over large amounts of data, and it is widely used for site search, log analysis, and retrieval in AI applications.
name: Elasticsearch
subtitle: Distributed search and vector database engine

description: eMastered is an online mastering service for finished songs, with controls for loudness and EQ. It was created by a team including Grammy-winning engineers and competes with LANDR.
name: eMastered
subtitle: Online AI audio mastering

description: Envision is an app and a pair of smart glasses that read text, describe scenes, and recognize people for users with low vision. It can also connect users to sighted volunteers by video call.
name: Envision
subtitle: Smart glasses and app that read text and describe surroundings

description: Excalidraw is a free, open-source virtual whiteboard for sketching diagrams that look hand-drawn. It supports live collaboration, shape libraries, and a text-to-diagram feature, and can be embedded in other tools.
name: Excalidraw
subtitle: Open-source virtual whiteboard with a hand-drawn look

description: FactSet provides financial data, research, and analytics to investment professionals. It covers company fundamentals, estimates, ownership, and market data, with a workstation, APIs, and generative AI search and summarization.
name: FactSet
subtitle: Financial data and analytics platform for investment professionals

description: FamilySearch is a free genealogy service run by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. It offers billions of historical records, a shared family tree, and AI tools that read handwriting to index scanned documents.
name: FamilySearch
subtitle: Free genealogy records from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

description: Figma Weave is a set of prebuilt AI workflows inside Figma Design for jobs like background replacement and style transfer. It adds image-editing and generation steps that designers can run without leaving their files.
name: Figma Weave
subtitle: More than 20 AI image workflows inside the Figma canvas

description: Filevine is cloud case management software for law firms. It tracks documents, deadlines, tasks, billing, and client communication, and has added AI tools for summarizing records, drafting documents, and handling intake.
name: Filevine
subtitle: Case management software for law firms

description: Final Cut Pro is Apple's professional video editor for Mac and iPad. It uses a magnetic timeline and machine learning features such as object tracking, automatic captions, voice isolation, and Magnetic Mask to speed up editing.
name: Final Cut Pro
subtitle: Apple's professional video editor for Mac and iPad

description: Finastra provides software for banks, covering core banking, lending, payments, and treasury. It is one of the larger vendors in financial technology, with products used by institutions around the world.
name: Finastra
subtitle: Banking and lending software for financial institutions

description: Find an AI Tools is a directory of AI tools that you can browse by category. Each listing links out to the tool's own site.
name: Find an AI Tools
subtitle: Directory for finding AI tools by category

description: Firebase is Google's platform for building web and mobile apps. It provides a hosted database, authentication, file storage, hosting, cloud functions, analytics, and crash reporting, with Gemini-powered tools to help write code and add AI features.
name: Firebase
subtitle: Google's app development platform

description: Flourish is a platform for building interactive charts, maps, and animated data stories without code. Canva owns it, and journalists, researchers, and designers use it to publish visualizations that readers can explore.
name: Flourish
subtitle: Interactive charts and data stories

description: Foxglove is a platform for recording, storing, and visualizing robot sensor data. It offers 2D and 3D panels, cloud search across recordings, and created MCAP, an open file format for robotics data.
name: Foxglove
subtitle: Visualization and observability platform for robots

description: Freightos runs WebCargo and an online marketplace where shippers compare rates and book international freight. It also publishes a widely cited freight rate index.
name: Freightos
subtitle: Online marketplace for international freight quotes

description: FullStory is a digital experience analytics platform that records user sessions and shows where people get stuck, rage click, or give up. Product, design, and support teams use it to find and fix problems, with AI summaries of sessions.
name: FullStory
subtitle: Digital experience analytics with session replay

description: FutureHouse is a nonprofit research lab building AI agents for science. Its agents, including Crow, Falcon, and Owl, support literature search and review, and its Robin system chained agents to propose a treatment candidate that it tested in the lab.
name: FutureHouse
subtitle: AI research agents for scientific literature and discovery

description: Garmin Pilot is an electronic flight bag app for flight planning, weather briefings, charts, and in-flight navigation. It pairs with Garmin avionics and is the closest rival to ForeFlight.
name: Garmin Pilot
subtitle: Flight planning and navigation app for pilots

description: Gemini CLI is an open-source command-line agent from Google. It reads a codebase, edits files, and runs commands using Gemini models, supports extensions and MCP, and offers a generous free tier with a Google account.
name: Gemini CLI
subtitle: Google's open-source coding agent for the terminal

description: Gemini Code Assist is Google's AI coding assistant. It provides code completion, chat, and agent-style code changes in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Google Cloud tools, with a free tier for individuals and enterprise plans.
name: Gemini Code Assist
subtitle: Google's AI coding assistant for IDEs and the command line

description: Gemini Spark is a personal AI agent from Google that takes actions for you instead of only answering questions. It runs in the background on cloud machines, connects to your Google apps and other services, and asks permission before important actions.
name: Gemini Spark
subtitle: Google's personal agent that works in the background across Gmail and Docs

description: GIMP is a free, open-source raster image editor for Linux, Windows, and macOS. It offers layers, masks, selection tools, filters, and plugins, and is the best-known free alternative to Photoshop.
name: GIMP
subtitle: Free open-source image editor

description: Agent HQ lets GitHub Copilot subscribers assign tasks to coding agents from several providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cognition, and xAI, inside GitHub, the command line, and VS Code. A Mission Control view tracks each agent's progress.
name: GitHub Agent HQ
subtitle: GitHubs hub for assigning work to coding agents from several AI labs

description: GitLab Duo adds AI to the GitLab platform, with code suggestions, chat, merge request summaries, root cause analysis for failed pipelines, and vulnerability explanations. It is a natural choice for teams already building and securing code on GitLab.
name: GitLab Duo
subtitle: AI assistant built into GitLab

description: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech converts text into natural-sounding audio through an API. It offers WaveNet, Neural2, Studio, and Chirp voices in many languages, SSML for control, and options for custom voices.
name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
subtitle: Google's API for natural-sounding speech in 50+ languages

description: Google Cloud Vision API detects labels, objects, text, faces, and landmarks in images. Developers use it to add image classification and OCR to apps, and it integrates with Google Cloud storage and AI tools.
name: Google Cloud Vision
subtitle: Image labeling, OCR, and object detection API

description: Google Document AI is a Google Cloud service for extracting data from documents. It offers prebuilt processors for invoices, receipts, IDs, and contracts, OCR, and custom extractors powered by Gemini.
name: Google Document AI
subtitle: Google Cloud service for parsing and classifying documents

description: Stitch is a Google Labs tool that uses Gemini to generate app and web interface designs from a text description or sketch. It produces editable designs, lets you iterate, and exports to Figma or code.
name: Google Stitch
subtitle: Google Labs tool that turns prompts into UI designs and front-end code

description: GPT4All, from Nomic, is a desktop app that downloads open models and runs them locally on your computer. It can chat over your own documents, needs no account, and keeps data on your device.
name: GPT4All
subtitle: Desktop app for running language models locally

description: Gradio is an open-source Python library for building web interfaces around machine learning models and functions in a few lines of code. It powers many demos on Hugging Face Spaces, and Hugging Face owns it.
name: Gradio
subtitle: Python library for building machine learning demo interfaces

description: Grafana is an open-source platform for building dashboards from metrics, logs, and traces pulled from many data sources. Grafana Labs also offers Grafana Cloud, a hosted observability service, and an AI assistant.
name: Grafana
subtitle: Open-source dashboards and observability stack

description: Graphite is a code review platform known for stacked pull requests, a merge queue, and AI-assisted review. Cursor acquired it, and it continues as its own product for teams using GitHub.
name: Graphite
subtitle: Code review platform built around stacked pull requests

description: Greptile indexes an entire repository so its pull request reviews can flag how a change affects code elsewhere. It posts comments on GitHub and GitLab and learns from the feedback reviewers give.
name: Greptile
subtitle: AI code review that understands the whole repository

description: H&R Block sells online tax preparation software and in-person tax help. Its AI Tax Assist answers filing questions inside the product, and customers can choose self-guided filing, expert review, or a full-service preparer.
name: H&R Block
subtitle: Tax preparation software and tax professionals

description: Headway condenses nonfiction books into short text and audio summaries and nudges users to build a daily reading habit. It is positioned as a lower-priced alternative to Blinkist.
name: Headway
subtitle: Book summary app with short daily reads

description: Heap is a product analytics tool that captures clicks, page views, and form entries automatically, so teams can define events after the fact instead of tagging them in code. It is now part of Contentsquare.
name: Heap
subtitle: Product analytics that captures user events automatically

description: Help Scout is a help desk built around a shared inbox that feels like email. It adds a knowledge base, live chat, and an AI assistant that drafts replies and summarizes conversations for small and mid-sized support teams.
name: Help Scout
subtitle: Shared inbox and help desk for customer support teams

description: Heroku is a platform as a service for deploying web apps and APIs with a git push. Owned by Salesforce, it offers managed Postgres, add-ons, and a growing set of AI services for hosting models and agents.
name: Heroku
subtitle: Salesforce's platform for deploying and running apps

description: HomeGauge is long-running software that home inspectors use to build inspection reports with photos and repair estimates. It competes with Spectora and similar tools.
name: HomeGauge
subtitle: Home inspection software and report writing

description: HoneyBook is client management software for freelancers and small creative businesses. It handles proposals, contracts, invoices, payments, scheduling, and a shared client timeline in one place.
name: HoneyBook
subtitle: Client management for freelancers and small studios

description: Housecall Pro is field service software for home service businesses such as plumbers, electricians, and HVAC companies. It handles scheduling, dispatch, estimates, invoicing, and payments, with a mobile app for technicians.
name: Housecall Pro
subtitle: Field service software for home service businesses

description: IBM Bob is an AI development partner for enterprise teams. Role-based agents help plan, code, test, and modernize software, with governance controls and support for older systems such as mainframe and IBM i code.
name: IBM Bob
subtitle: IBMs agentic development partner for enterprise teams

description: Icertis is a contract lifecycle management platform for large enterprises. It covers contract authoring, approvals, obligations, and renewals, and uses AI to extract terms, analyze risk, and answer questions about agreements.
name: Icertis
subtitle: Enterprise contract lifecycle management platform

description: ImageTrend sells electronic patient care reporting and data tools to emergency medical services and fire departments. Agencies use it to document calls, track outcomes, and report to state registries.
name: ImageTrend
subtitle: Records and data software for EMS and fire agencies

description: Infura provides hosted node access and APIs for Ethereum and other blockchains, so developers don't have to run their own nodes. It's owned by Consensys and is a default connection for MetaMask.
name: Infura
subtitle: Ethereum and web3 API infrastructure from Consensys

description: Inkscape is a free, open-source vector graphics editor that uses SVG as its native format. It's used for logos, icons, diagrams, and illustrations, and is a popular free alternative to Adobe Illustrator.
name: Inkscape
subtitle: Free open-source vector graphics editor

description: Insight Timer is a meditation app with a large free library of guided meditations, music, and talks from thousands of teachers. A paid tier adds courses, offline use, and extra features.
name: Insight Timer
subtitle: Free meditation app with a large library of guided sessions

description: Invoke is an image generation tool with a layered canvas for inpainting and compositing. The open-source version runs locally on your own GPU, and there is a hosted option for teams.
name: Invoke
subtitle: Creative engine for Stable Diffusion and Flux with a canvas UI

description: IQVIA is a large provider of healthcare data, analytics, and clinical research services. Pharmaceutical companies use it for prescription and patient data, market insights, and running clinical trials, with growing use of AI and agents.
name: IQVIA
subtitle: Healthcare data, analytics, and clinical research services

description: iRhythm makes the Zio patch, a wearable heart monitor worn for up to two weeks. Its algorithms analyze the recording to find arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation, and cardiologists review the results.
name: iRhythm
subtitle: Wearable ECG patch with AI rhythm analysis

description: Justworks provides payroll, benefits, and HR compliance for small businesses. As a professional employer organization, it acts as co-employer, giving customers access to group health plans and handling filings.
name: Justworks
subtitle: Payroll, benefits, and HR for small businesses

description: Kaggle, owned by Google, is a platform for data science and machine learning. It hosts competitions, public datasets, free cloud notebooks with GPUs, models, and short courses, and has a large community of practitioners.
name: Kaggle
subtitle: Data science community with competitions, datasets, and notebooks

description: KAYAK is a travel search engine that compares prices for flights, hotels, rental cars, and packages across many booking sites. It offers price alerts, fare forecasts, and AI-assisted search, and is part of Booking Holdings.
name: KAYAK
subtitle: Travel search engine for flights, hotels, and cars

description: Keap, formerly Infusionsoft, is a CRM and marketing automation tool for small businesses. It combines contact management, email and text automation, invoicing, payments, and appointment booking. Thryv owns it.
name: Keap
subtitle: CRM and marketing automation for small businesses

description: KiCad is a free, open-source suite for electronic design automation. It covers schematic capture, PCB layout, 3D viewing, and manufacturing outputs, and is used by hobbyists, companies, and educators as a free alternative to commercial tools.
name: KiCad
subtitle: Free open-source PCB design suite

description: Kinexon uses wearable sensors and ultra-wideband positioning to track athletes and equipment in real time. Professional sports teams use the data for performance and load monitoring, and it also serves factories and logistics.
name: Kinexon
subtitle: Real-time location tracking for sports teams and industry

description: Klue collects competitor news, pricing changes, and win and loss notes into battlecards that sales teams use in deals. AI summarizes competitor updates.
name: Klue
subtitle: Competitive intelligence platform for sales and product marketing

description: Kore.ai provides a platform for building conversational AI assistants and agents for customer service, IT help desks, and HR. It targets large enterprises with prebuilt industry templates and many channel integrations.
name: Kore.ai
subtitle: Enterprise conversational AI and virtual assistant platform

description: Label Studio is an open-source data labeling tool from HumanSignal. It handles text, images, audio, video, and time series in one interface, supports model-assisted labeling, and has an enterprise version with team features.
name: Label Studio
subtitle: Open-source data labeling for text, images, audio, and video

description: LangGraph is an open-source framework from the LangChain team for building stateful agents as graphs of steps. It supports branching, loops, persistent memory, human approval steps, and streaming, and pairs with LangSmith for deployment and monitoring.
name: LangGraph
subtitle: Graph-based framework for stateful, long-running agents

description: LegalOn reviews contracts in Word against checklists written by practicing lawyers and suggests revisions. It began in Japan as LegalForce and now sells in the US and elsewhere.
name: LegalOn
subtitle: AI contract review built with lawyer-written playbooks

description: LegalZoom provides online legal services for individuals and small businesses, including forming companies, writing wills, filing trademarks, and getting attorney advice. It combines guided software with human review on some plans.
name: LegalZoom
subtitle: Online legal documents and business formation

description: Legora, formerly Leya, is an AI platform for law firms that handles contract review, legal research, and drafting. It works inside Microsoft Word, offers a collaborative workspace for legal teams, and has grown quickly in Europe and the United States.
name: Legora
subtitle: AI workspace for lawyers, built in Sweden

description: lemlist is a sales outreach tool for cold email, LinkedIn, and calls. It sends personalized sequences, includes a lead database and inbox warm-up, and became known for custom images and videos in outreach.
name: lemlist
subtitle: Multichannel outreach by email, LinkedIn, and phone

description: Protégé is LexisNexis's AI assistant for lawyers. It handles legal research, document summaries, and drafting, including inside Microsoft Word, and grounds its answers in LexisNexis content with citations.
name: LexisNexis Protégé
subtitle: AI legal assistant built on LexisNexis content

description: Libsyn is one of the oldest podcast hosting services. It stores episodes, distributes them to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other apps, and offers download statistics, advertising tools, and a website and player.
name: Libsyn
subtitle: Long-running podcast hosting and distribution service

description: LiveKit is open-source infrastructure for real-time audio and video, along with an Agents framework for building voice AI. Developers use it to add video calls, livestreams, and conversational agents to apps, and run it in LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted.
name: LiveKit
subtitle: Open-source real-time audio and video infrastructure for voice agents

description: LivePerson sells messaging and conversational AI to large brands for customer service over web chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and Apple Messages. Companies use it to automate requests and route harder ones to human agents.
name: LivePerson
subtitle: Conversational AI and messaging for customer service

description: LMArena, now Arena, is a public leaderboard that ranks AI models through blind head-to-head voting. People compare two anonymous answers to the same prompt and pick the better one, and the votes are turned into rankings.
name: LMArena
subtitle: Crowd-voted leaderboard that ranks AI models head to head

description: Lumen5 converts blog posts, articles, and scripts into short videos by matching text to stock footage, images, and music. Marketing teams use it to repurpose written content for social media and websites.
name: Lumen5
subtitle: Video maker that turns articles into short videos

description: MagicSchool is an AI platform for teachers with dozens of tools for lesson plans, rubrics, quizzes, differentiation, and parent emails. It also offers a student-facing chat with teacher controls, and has free and school plans.
name: MagicSchool
subtitle: AI platform for teachers with lesson planning and student chat tools

description: Magnet Forensics makes digital forensics software for investigators. Magnet AXIOM collects and analyzes evidence from phones, computers, and cloud accounts. It merged with Grayshift, maker of the GrayKey phone-unlocking tool.
name: Magnet Forensics
subtitle: Digital forensics software for investigators

description: Maltego is an investigation tool that maps relationships between people, companies, domains, accounts, and infrastructure using public data and commercial sources. Security teams and investigators use it to build link graphs.
name: Maltego
subtitle: Link analysis and OSINT investigation tool

description: Mangools is a bundle of SEO tools including KWFinder, SERPChecker, SERPWatcher, LinkMiner, and SiteProfiler. It has a simpler interface and lower price than larger SEO suites, which suits freelancers and small sites.
name: Mangools
subtitle: Beginner-friendly SEO tools for keywords and SERP analysis

description: MasterControl provides quality management, document control, and manufacturing execution software for life sciences. Companies use it to manage compliance and stay ready for audits.
name: MasterControl
subtitle: Quality and manufacturing software for regulated industries

description: Matillion builds data pipelines that run inside cloud warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and Databricks. Its Maia agents can build, debug, and document pipelines from a plain-language request.
name: Matillion
subtitle: Cloud data pipeline and transformation platform

description: Meilisearch is an open-source search engine written in Rust. It offers typo tolerance, filters, facets, and hybrid keyword and semantic search, and is simple to set up for product catalogs, documentation, and app search.
name: Meilisearch
subtitle: Open-source search engine with hybrid and vector search

description: Meltano is an open-source command line tool for building data pipelines from Singer taps and targets, defined as code. Teams that want to self-host and version control their data integration use it.
name: Meltano
subtitle: Open-source ELT framework built on Singer connectors

description: Memrise teaches vocabulary and phrases through spaced repetition and short videos of native speakers. It has added AI conversation partners that let learners practice speaking and get feedback.
name: Memrise
subtitle: Language learning with spaced repetition and native speaker videos

description: Mendeley is a reference manager that stores and annotates research papers, builds citations and bibliographies, and syncs across devices. Elsevier owns it, and it competes with Zotero.
name: Mendeley
subtitle: Elsevier's reference manager and academic network

description: Mentimeter lets presenters add live polls, word clouds, quizzes, and Q&A that the audience answers on their phones. It's used by teachers, trainers, and meeting hosts, and includes AI to generate questions and slides.
name: Mentimeter
subtitle: Interactive presentations with live polls and Q&A

description: Merlin Bird ID is a free app from the Cornell Lab of Ornithology that identifies birds from a photo, a recording of their song, or answers to a few questions. It works offline with downloadable regional bird packs.
name: Merlin Bird ID
subtitle: Free bird identification app from the Cornell Lab of Ornithology

description: MetaHuman is Epic Games' framework for creating realistic digital humans with full rigs and facial animation. You can build characters in MetaHuman Creator, scan faces, and animate with performance capture, for use in Unreal Engine.
name: MetaHuman
subtitle: Epic Games' tool for creating realistic digital humans

description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant for work. It drafts documents, summarizes email and meetings, builds presentations, and analyzes spreadsheets inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, using your organization's data.
name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
subtitle: AI assistant inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams

description: Microsoft Clarity is a free tool that records user sessions and creates click and scroll heatmaps for websites and apps. It flags rage clicks and dead clicks, and uses Copilot to summarize sessions, with no traffic limits.
name: Microsoft Clarity
subtitle: Free heatmaps and session recordings

description: Copilot Studio is Microsoft's low-code platform for building agents and copilots. Agents can run in Teams, Microsoft 365, and on the web, and connect to company data and systems through connectors and the Power Platform.
name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
subtitle: Low-code builder for agents that run in Microsoft 365 and Teams

description: Dynamics 365 is Microsoft's suite of business applications for sales, customer service, marketing, finance, and supply chain. Copilot features draft emails, summarize accounts, and help with analysis across the apps.
name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
subtitle: Microsoft's CRM and ERP suite with Copilot

description: Microsoft Entra ID, formerly Azure Active Directory, is Microsoft's cloud identity service. It handles sign-in, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and access policies for Microsoft 365, Azure, and thousands of other apps.
name: Microsoft Entra ID
subtitle: Microsoft's cloud identity and access management service

description: Microsoft Power Apps is a low-code platform for building business apps on data from Excel, SharePoint, Dataverse, and hundreds of other sources. Copilot can generate an app from a description.
name: Microsoft Power Apps
subtitle: Low-code app builder in the Microsoft Power Platform

description: Microsoft Security Copilot is a generative AI assistant for security teams. It helps analysts investigate incidents, summarize alerts, write queries in plain language, and automate tasks using AI agents, integrating with Defender, Sentinel, Intune, Entra, and Purview.
name: Microsoft Security Copilot
subtitle: Generative AI assistant for security analysts

description: Mighty Networks lets creators and brands run paid communities with discussion, courses, events, and a branded mobile app. Its AI assistant helps set up a community, draft content, and answer member questions.
name: Mighty Networks
subtitle: Community platform with courses and memberships

description: Mindtickle combines training, content, and call practice to help new sales reps become productive faster. Managers track which skills reps have and where they need coaching.
name: Mindtickle
subtitle: Sales readiness and coaching platform

description: Vibe is Mistral AI's coding and work agent. It includes an open-source command-line tool for coding tasks, built on Mistral's Devstral and Large models, which can be deployed on a company's own infrastructure.
name: Mistral Vibe
subtitle: Mistrals agent for coding and everyday work tasks

description: Mixpanel is a product analytics platform that tracks what people do in an app or website and shows funnels, retention, and cohorts. It also offers session replay, experiments, and an AI assistant for exploring data.
name: Mixpanel
subtitle: Product analytics for tracking user events and funnels

description: Moderne runs OpenRewrite recipes across thousands of repositories at once, handling framework upgrades, dependency bumps, and security fixes. It was built by the creators of OpenRewrite.
name: Moderne
subtitle: Automated code refactoring and migrations at scale

description: MoEngage is a customer engagement platform that sends push notifications, email, SMS, and in-app messages based on user behavior. Consumer apps use it, and AI helps with send-time optimization and segmentation.
name: MoEngage
subtitle: Customer engagement platform for mobile-first brands

description: MongoDB Atlas is the fully managed cloud service for MongoDB, a document database. It runs on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud and includes Atlas Vector Search, so teams can store embeddings next to application data for AI features.
name: MongoDB Atlas
subtitle: Managed MongoDB with built-in vector search

description: Morgen combines calendars from several accounts with a task list and can plan your day by placing tasks into open time. It also offers scheduling links for bookings.
name: Morgen
subtitle: Calendar and task planner that blocks time for your to-dos

description: Motive, formerly KeepTruckin, offers electronic logging devices, GPS fleet tracking, AI dashcams, and spend management for trucking and field service fleets. Its AI detects risky driving and supports compliance.
name: Motive
subtitle: Fleet management with AI dashcams and driver safety

description: MURAL is a digital whiteboard for workshops, planning, and brainstorming. It offers templates and facilitation tools like timers and voting, and AI that clusters and summarizes sticky notes.
name: MURAL
subtitle: Digital whiteboard for team workshops and brainstorming

description: MX connects to bank accounts, cleans up the transaction data, and provides it to banks and fintech apps for budgeting and insights. It competes with Plaid and Yodlee.
name: MX
subtitle: Financial data aggregation and money management tools for banks

description: MyTherapy reminds people to take their medications and logs symptoms, measurements, and mood. It generates reports patients can share with their doctors.
name: MyTherapy
subtitle: Medication reminder and health tracking app

description: Nansen is a blockchain analytics platform that labels wallets so users can see what funds, exchanges, and known traders are doing. Crypto traders and researchers use it to track token flows and smart money activity.
name: Nansen
subtitle: On-chain analytics with labeled wallets

description: NemoClaw is NVIDIA's open-source enterprise layer for OpenClaw agents. It adds a sandboxed runtime, policy and privacy controls, and NVIDIA's Nemotron models, aimed at companies concerned about security when running autonomous agents.
name: NemoClaw
subtitle: NVIDIAs open platform for running enterprise AI agents with security controls

description: NeuronWriter analyzes the top search results for a keyword and scores a draft against them, suggesting terms, headings, and length. It is a lower-priced alternative to Surfer and Clearscope.
name: NeuronWriter
subtitle: SEO content optimization using search results analysis

description: NocoDB puts a spreadsheet interface on top of existing databases such as MySQL and Postgres. It is open source and self-hostable, with forms, kanban and gallery views, and an API.
name: NocoDB
subtitle: Open-source Airtable alternative that sits on top of your database

description: Nomi is an AI companion app where you create a character and talk to it over time. It is known for remembering past conversations and for letting users shape the relationship, from friend to romantic partner.
name: Nomi
subtitle: AI companion with long-term memory

description: Notable sells AI agents that handle patient intake, scheduling, and referral work for health systems. The agents connect to the electronic health record and complete tasks that staff would otherwise do by hand.
name: Notable
subtitle: AI agents for patient intake and healthcare operations

description: Custom Agents in Notion are background AI agents that run on a schedule or when an event happens, such as a new comment or database change. Each run is logged so changes can be reviewed and undone, and agents use Notion credits on Business and Enterprise plans.
name: Notion Custom Agents
subtitle: Background agents in Notion that run on a schedule or on triggers

description: CUDA is NVIDIA's platform for running general-purpose code on its GPUs. It includes a compiler, runtime, and libraries such as cuDNN and cuBLAS, and nearly every major deep learning framework relies on it.
name: NVIDIA CUDA
subtitle: NVIDIA's GPU computing platform and toolkit

description: o9 Solutions sells a planning platform that connects demand forecasting, supply planning, and finance in one data model. It competes with Kinaxis and Blue Yonder at large manufacturers and retailers.
name: o9 Solutions
subtitle: AI planning platform for supply chains and revenue

description: OpenSolar is a free software platform for designing solar systems, generating 3D proposals, and sending quotes with financing options. It makes money through payments and add-on services rather than seat fees.
name: OpenSolar
subtitle: Free solar design and proposal software

description: OpenTools is a directory of thousands of AI tools that can be filtered by task, category, and pricing. It also lists AI models, MCP servers, and experts, and publishes guides and community news.
name: OpenTools
subtitle: AI tools directory with models, MCP servers and news

description: Optimizely is a digital experience platform with content management, experimentation, personalization, and commerce tools. Marketing and product teams use it to run A/B tests, manage feature flags, and tailor experiences, with AI agents to help.
name: Optimizely
subtitle: Experimentation and content platform for digital teams

description: Oracle NetSuite is a cloud ERP system for accounting, inventory, order management, billing, and CRM, aimed at growing and mid-sized businesses. It includes generative AI features that summarize data, draft text, and assist with analysis.
name: Oracle NetSuite
subtitle: Cloud ERP and accounting for growing companies

description: OrcaSlicer is a free, open-source slicer for FDM 3D printers. It supports Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, and many other brands, and adds calibration tools and finer print controls than the slicers it grew from.
name: OrcaSlicer
subtitle: Open-source 3D printing slicer forked from Bambu Studio

description: The Oura Ring is a wearable health tracker worn on the finger. It measures sleep, heart rate, activity, and body temperature, and the app turns the data into daily readiness and sleep scores, with an AI advisor for questions.
name: Oura Ring
subtitle: Smart ring for sleep, recovery, and readiness tracking

description: Paychex provides payroll, benefits, insurance, and HR services for small and mid-sized businesses, with human support included. Its Flex platform combines these tools, and it acquired Paycor to expand into larger employers.
name: Paychex
subtitle: Payroll and HR services for small and mid-size businesses

description: Paycom runs payroll, time tracking, talent management, and benefits from a single database. Its Beti feature has employees review and correct their own pay before payroll runs, which reduces corrections afterward.
name: Paycom
subtitle: Single-database payroll and HR platform

description: Paylocity sells payroll, benefits, time tracking, and talent tools to mid-sized employers. Its AI assistant answers employee questions about pay and policies and helps HR teams with routine tasks.
name: Paylocity
subtitle: Payroll and HR software for mid-size companies

description: Pendo is a product experience platform. It tracks how people use software, adds in-app guides, tooltips, and surveys without engineering help, and uses AI to analyze usage, summarize feedback, and analyze how AI agents are used.
name: Pendo
subtitle: Product analytics and in-app guidance

description: Percy takes screenshots of a web app on each commit and flags visual differences for review. It is part of BrowserStack and uses AI to filter noise from small rendering changes.
name: Percy
subtitle: Visual testing and review platform from BrowserStack

description: Perplexity Computer is a cloud-based agent from Perplexity. It breaks a goal into subtasks, assigns each to the model best suited for it, connects to hundreds of apps, and works in a managed sandbox so tasks continue without your browser open.
name: Perplexity Computer
subtitle: Perplexitys cloud agent for multistep tasks

description: Persefoni is a carbon accounting platform that measures a company's Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions and produces reports for regulators and investors. It includes an AI assistant for carbon accounting questions.
name: Persefoni
subtitle: Carbon accounting and climate disclosure platform

description: Photomath is a math app that reads a problem from a photo and shows step-by-step solutions with explanations. Google acquired it, and it's widely used by students for homework help and learning.
name: Photomath
subtitle: Camera app that solves and explains math problems

description: Physical Intelligence is a robotics company building general-purpose models that let robots perform many tasks. It has published its pi-zero models, with open code on GitHub, and aims for a single model that works across robot types.
name: Physical Intelligence
subtitle: Foundation models for general-purpose robots

description: Pigment is a business planning platform for finance, sales, and operations teams. It handles budgeting, forecasting, and scenario modeling in a spreadsheet-like interface, with AI agents for analysis and reporting.
name: Pigment
subtitle: Business planning platform for finance teams

description: Planhat pulls product usage, support, and billing data into a single view of each account. Customer success teams use it to track health scores, renewals, and expansion.
name: Planhat
subtitle: Customer platform for customer success teams

description: Plausible is a lightweight, open-source web analytics tool that measures traffic without cookies. It shows key metrics on a single page and is a popular privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics.
name: Plausible
subtitle: Lightweight, privacy-friendly web analytics

description: Poised listens during video calls and gives private feedback on pace, filler words, and tone. It also offers practice sessions for presentations and speaking.
name: Poised
subtitle: AI communication coach for meetings and calls

description: Postscript is an SMS marketing platform built for Shopify merchants. It handles subscriber collection, campaigns, and automated flows such as abandoned cart texts, with AI help for writing and targeting.
name: Postscript
subtitle: SMS marketing platform for Shopify stores

description: Prezi creates presentations on a single large canvas and zooms between topics instead of moving slide by slide. It includes Prezi Present, Video, and Design products, with an AI assistant for generating and refining presentations.
name: Prezi
subtitle: Presentation software built around a zooming canvas

description: Product Hunt is a website where people launch and discover new products, which are ranked each day by community votes. Each product has a page with comments, makers, and topic tags, and AI products make up a large share.
name: Product Hunt
subtitle: Daily ranked launches of new tech products, including AI tools

description: QGIS is a free, open-source desktop geographic information system for viewing, editing, and analyzing spatial data. It has a large plugin library, including plugins for machine learning and remote sensing, and works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
name: QGIS
subtitle: Free open-source geographic information system

description: Qlik sells analytics and data integration software. Qlik Sense uses an associative engine that lets users explore data freely, and Qlik Cloud adds AutoML, AI assistants, and data integration, including Talend.
name: Qlik
subtitle: Business intelligence and data integration platform

description: Qualio is a cloud quality management system for medical device and biotech companies. It handles document control, training records, supplier management, and audits for FDA and ISO compliance.
name: Qualio
subtitle: Quality management software for life sciences

description: Questel provides patent search, analytics, and IP portfolio management software used by law firms and corporate IP teams. It is one of the larger independent vendors in intellectual property tools.
name: Questel
subtitle: Patent search and intellectual property management

description: QuickBooks is Intuit's accounting software for small businesses. It handles invoicing, expenses, bank feeds, payroll, reports, and tax preparation, and Intuit Assist adds AI that categorizes transactions and answers questions about your books.
name: QuickBooks
subtitle: Intuit's accounting software for small businesses

description: QuickNode provides fast RPC endpoints for dozens of blockchains, plus APIs for token, NFT, and transaction data. Developers use it to read from and send to chains without running their own nodes.
name: QuickNode
subtitle: Blockchain RPC endpoints and data APIs across many chains

description: Qure.ai builds deep learning software that flags findings on chest X-rays and head CT scans, including tuberculosis, lung nodules, and brain bleeds. It is deployed in hospitals and screening programs across many countries.
name: Qure.ai
subtitle: AI for chest X-ray and head CT interpretation

description: Rasa is an open-source framework for building chat and voice assistants that run on infrastructure you control. Larger companies choose it when they need data to stay in-house and want control over dialogue logic.
name: Rasa
subtitle: Open-source framework for building conversational assistants

description: Rask AI transcribes a video, translates it, and generates a dubbed voiceover in the target language, with lip sync and voice cloning available on some plans. Creators and companies use it to localize videos.
name: Rask AI
subtitle: AI video translation and dubbing

description: ReadMe builds developer hubs and API references where readers can try calls right from the page. It shows API owners usage metrics and includes an AI search assistant.
name: ReadMe
subtitle: API documentation platform with interactive references

description: Redis is an in-memory data store used for caching, queues, sessions, and real-time features. It also supports vector search, JSON, and semantic caching, so teams use it for AI applications that need fast lookups.
name: Redis
subtitle: In-memory database used for caching and vector search

description: Remote lets companies hire and pay people in other countries without setting up a local entity. It acts as employer of record and handles contracts, payroll, benefits, and compliance, and also supports contractors.
name: Remote
subtitle: Global payroll, HR, and employer-of-record service

description: Replit Agent 4 is the latest version of Replit's app-building agent. It builds and deploys apps from a description in the browser, runs faster than earlier versions, and adds a canvas for working on spreadsheets, charts, and games alongside code.
name: Replit Agent 4
subtitle: Replits app-building agent with a canvas interface

description: Retell lets developers build AI phone agents that handle inbound and outbound calls with low latency. Businesses use it for support lines, appointment booking, and lead qualification.
name: Retell AI
subtitle: Voice agent platform for phone calls

description: Rocket Lawyer provides legal document templates and access to attorneys through a membership. It covers contracts, business filings, and estate planning for small businesses and consumers, and has added AI help.
name: Rocket Lawyer
subtitle: Legal documents and attorney access by subscription

description: RoseTTAFold is a deep learning model from David Baker's lab at the University of Washington that predicts protein structures. The lab has also released related tools such as RFdiffusion for designing new proteins.
name: RoseTTAFold
subtitle: Open protein structure prediction from the Baker lab

description: Agentforce is Salesforce's platform for building and running AI agents that work with CRM data, Slack, and Data Cloud. It includes ready-made agents for sales, service, and marketing, plus tools for companies to create their own.
name: Salesforce Agentforce
subtitle: Salesforce platform for AI agents inside CRM, Slack and Data Cloud

description: SAP Concur handles business travel booking, expense reports, and invoice management, and is one of the most widely used expense systems in large enterprises. It uses automation and AI to capture receipts, apply policy, and detect problems.
name: SAP Concur
subtitle: Travel and expense management for large companies

description: Joule is SAP's AI assistant across its business applications. It answers questions in natural language, carries out tasks, and works with agents that users can build in Joule Studio, grounded in company data and permissions.
name: SAP Joule
subtitle: SAPs AI assistant and agent platform built into its business applications

description: SAP Signavio maps and analyzes business processes, including process mining on system event logs. It is SAP's answer to Celonis and is most useful to companies already running SAP.
name: SAP Signavio
subtitle: Process mining and business process management

description: Sardine uses device intelligence and behavior signals to stop fraud in real time for fintechs and banks. It also sells AI agents that handle compliance work such as KYC onboarding checks and transaction reviews.
name: Sardine
subtitle: AI risk platform for fraud, compliance, and underwriting

description: SavvyCal is a scheduling tool where the person booking can see their own calendar next to yours. You can rank your preferred times, and invitees are nudged toward those slots.
name: SavvyCal
subtitle: Scheduling links that let invitees overlay their own calendar

description: Scopus is Elsevier's large abstract and citation database for peer-reviewed literature. It supports literature search, author and journal metrics, and research evaluation, and includes Scopus AI for summaries and answers.
name: Scopus
subtitle: Elsevier's abstract and citation database

description: Secureframe connects to a company's cloud and HR systems to collect evidence for audits like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Its AI features draft policies and answer security questionnaires.
name: Secureframe
subtitle: Compliance automation for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and more

description: Securiti finds and classifies sensitive data across a company's systems, then enforces privacy rules and access controls. It also covers governance for AI models that use that data. Veeam acquired it.
name: Securiti
subtitle: Data security, privacy, and AI governance platform

description: Seeing AI is a free Microsoft app for blind and low-vision people. It reads text aloud, describes scenes, identifies products by barcode, recognizes currency and colors, and can describe people, using the phone's camera.
name: Seeing AI
subtitle: Microsoft's free app that describes the world to blind users

description: SemiLaunch is a weekly launch platform in the style of Product Hunt, where makers submit a product and collect votes and feedback during a launch week. It accepts any kind of product, not only software.
name: SemiLaunch
subtitle: Weekly product launch platform for indie makers

description: SentinelOne sells endpoint, cloud, and identity security built on its Singularity platform. Its AI detects and responds to threats automatically, and Purple AI helps analysts investigate and hunt for attacks in plain language.
name: SentinelOne
subtitle: AI endpoint and cloud security platform

description: Otto is ServiceNow's AI experience that brings together Now Assist, Moveworks conversational search, and AI agents. Employees use it to ask questions and get work done across systems under ServiceNow's governance controls.
name: ServiceNow Otto
subtitle: ServiceNow AI interface combining Now Assist, Moveworks and agents

description: Shortform writes detailed guides to nonfiction books that run longer than a typical summary and add commentary and context. It also has article and exercise guides.
name: Shortform
subtitle: Long-form book guides with analysis and commentary

description: Sierra builds AI agents for customer service. Founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor, it supplies enterprises with conversational agents that handle support over chat and voice, take actions in company systems, and are priced by outcomes.
name: Sierra
subtitle: AI agents for customer service, built for large brands

description: Skool combines a discussion feed, online classroom, calendar, and leaderboard into one paid community product. It is popular with creators and coaches who sell memberships.
name: Skool
subtitle: Community and course platform for creators

description: Slackbot is Slack's AI assistant, rebuilt as an agent that can search channels, draft content, schedule meetings, and take actions in Slack, and hand work to Salesforce Agentforce agents. It is included in higher Slack plans.
name: Slackbot
subtitle: Slacks AI agent that answers questions and acts across your workspace

description: Smartlead sends cold email campaigns from many inboxes at once, rotating senders and warming up new accounts to protect deliverability. Agencies use it to run outreach for multiple clients.
name: Smartlead
subtitle: Cold email outreach with inbox rotation and warm-up

description: SnapGene is molecular biology software for designing cloning experiments, annotating plasmids, and simulating PCR and digests. It's widely used in labs and is now part of Dotmatics.
name: SnapGene
subtitle: Molecular biology software for planning and visualizing DNA constructs

description: Snorkel AI grew out of a Stanford research project on weak supervision. It helps teams build training and evaluation data by writing labeling functions and using experts to review, instead of labeling every example by hand.
name: Snorkel AI
subtitle: Programmatic data labeling and development platform

description: SonarQube is a code quality and security tool that scans code for bugs, vulnerabilities, and maintainability problems across dozens of languages. It enforces quality gates in CI pipelines and has AI features to suggest fixes.
name: SonarQube
subtitle: Static analysis for code quality and security

description: Speak is a language learning app centered on speaking with an AI tutor. Lessons have you talk through scenarios and get corrections, and it offers roleplays and a conversational practice mode for English, Spanish, and other languages.
name: Speak
subtitle: AI language tutor focused on speaking out loud

description: Splunk, now part of Cisco, collects and searches machine data for monitoring, troubleshooting, and security. Organizations use it for log analytics, SIEM, and observability, with AI assistants for search and investigation.
name: Splunk
subtitle: Log analytics, observability, and security platform

description: SpyFu shows which keywords competitors rank for and bid on, along with their ad copy history. It is cheaper than Semrush or Ahrefs and is popular with small agencies for PPC research.
name: SpyFu
subtitle: Competitor keyword and ad research tool

description: Squarespace is a website builder known for polished templates. It covers sites, blogs, online stores, and scheduling, with AI tools that help generate a site, write text, and design layouts. It is owned by a private equity firm.
name: Squarespace
subtitle: Website builder with templates, commerce, and AI design tools

description: Squibler helps authors outline a book, draft chapters, and keep track of characters and plot. It also exports to common ebook and print formats.
name: Squibler
subtitle: AI book writing tool with outlining and story planning

description: Storylane lets teams capture a product and turn it into clickable demos. Sales and marketing teams embed the demos on websites and in emails, with AI voiceover, personalization, and analytics on viewer behavior.
name: Storylane
subtitle: Interactive product demo builder

description: Storytel is a subscription service for audiobooks and ebooks with a large catalog in Northern Europe and availability in other regions. Its VoiceSwitcher feature, built with ElevenLabs, lets listeners switch between a human narrator and an AI voice.
name: Storytel
subtitle: Audiobook and ebook subscription service

description: Streamlit is an open-source Python framework for turning scripts into interactive web apps with a few lines of code. It's popular for data dashboards, machine learning demos, and chat interfaces, and is owned by Snowflake.
name: Streamlit
subtitle: Open-source Python framework for building data apps

description: The Agentic Commerce Suite is Stripe's set of tools for letting AI agents buy things. Merchants can sell through agents, and agents get payment methods such as virtual cards or stablecoin payments, built on open protocols.
name: Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite
subtitle: Stripe tools for letting AI agents pay and merchants sell to them

description: Substack is a platform for publishing newsletters and podcasts, with built-in subscriptions and payments. Writers own their email lists and can charge readers, and there is a reading app and a social feed called Notes.
name: Substack
subtitle: Newsletter publishing with built-in paid subscriptions

description: Sumsub verifies customers with ID document checks, liveness detection, and anti-money laundering screening. Fintechs, crypto platforms, and marketplaces use it to onboard users and meet know-your-customer rules.
name: Sumsub
subtitle: Identity verification and KYC platform

description: SuperAGI is an open-source platform for building and running agents, with a graphical interface, a tool marketplace, and telemetry on agent performance. It targets developers who want an agent runtime.
name: SuperAGI
subtitle: Open-source framework for running autonomous agents

description: Superwhisper turns speech into text in any app on macOS and can run Whisper models on the device, so audio stays on the computer. Custom modes reformat the transcript for emails, notes, or code comments.
name: Superwhisper
subtitle: Voice dictation for Mac and iPhone using Whisper models

description: Surge AI provides human data for AI training, including annotation for reinforcement learning from human feedback, model evaluation, and red teaming. It focuses on skilled raters and works with frontier AI labs.
name: Surge AI
subtitle: High-quality human data for training and evaluating models

name: Tractive

description: UKG, formed from the merger of Ultimate Software and Kronos, sells HR, payroll, and workforce management software to large employers. Its platform covers scheduling, time and attendance, talent, and pay, with AI features for insights and assistance.

name: UserWay

name: Veeva Systems

name: Vertex

name: Vidyard

name: Virtual Staging AI
subtitle: AI virtual staging for real estate photos

description: Wrike is a work management platform with Gantt charts, boards, dashboards, request forms, and approvals. Its AI summarizes tasks, drafts content, and flags risks to project timelines, and it targets teams that run many projects.

description: MyHeritage helps people build family trees and match them against billions of historical records. It uses AI to colorize and animate old photos and to search archival documents automatically.

name: Paperpal

description: Perfect365 is a photo editing app that lets people try hairstyles, hair colors, and makeup looks on their own photos before visiting a salon. Stylists use it to show clients how a change might look.

description: Quizgecko turns text, documents, or URLs into multiple-choice, true or false, and short-answer quizzes using AI. Instructional designers and trainers use it to build knowledge checks.

name: Rogo

name: Sales Boomerang
subtitle: AI mortgage lead alert and borrower retention platform

name: Seequent

description: Shift Technology builds AI that detects fraud and automates claims decisions for insurance carriers. It analyzes claims data, policy history, and external signals to flag suspicious claims and speed up legitimate ones.
name: Shift Technology

description: SimplePractice is practice management software for therapists, counselors, and other behavioral health providers. It handles scheduling, billing, notes, and telehealth, with AI help for documentation.

name: Smartify
subtitle: AI artwork recognition app for museums and galleries

description: Spectora turns a home inspector's photos and voice notes into a formatted report, using AI to help write defect summaries and suggest repair language. Inspectors use it to cut report writing time.
name: Spectora
subtitle: AI-assisted home inspection report software

description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data-driven recommendations with human stylists. Clients share their size, budget, and style, and receive selected clothing to try at home, paying only for what they keep.
name: Stitch Fix
subtitle: AI-assisted personal styling and clothing selection

description: StyleSeat is a booking marketplace and business tool for hair stylists, colorists, and other beauty professionals. AI-driven recommendations match clients with nearby pros, and it handles scheduling and payments.
name: StyleSeat

description: Tracers combines public records, court filings, and licensed data sources into one search for background checks, skip tracing, and asset searches. Investigators and collections professionals use it.

name: Transkribus

description: Trinka is an AI writing assistant for academic and technical writing. It checks grammar, tone, and subject-specific terminology, and catches issues that generic grammar checkers miss.
name: Trinka
subtitle: AI grammar and language checker built for academic and technical writing

description: Upheal is an AI platform for therapists that transcribes sessions and generates clinical notes, treatment plans, and progress summaries. It supports formats like SOAP and DAP.
name: Upheal
subtitle: AI clinical notes and treatment plan generator for therapists

description: Vagaro is a scheduling and point-of-sale platform for salons, spas, and wellness studios. Its AI assistant helps with appointment booking, reminders, and suggestions for growth.
name: Vagaro
subtitle: Online booking and business management platform for salons and spas

name: VidIQ

name: Visier
subtitle: AI workforce analytics platform for people leaders

description: Vivino identifies wine from a photo of its label and shows ratings, reviews, and pairing notes from a large community of users. It also sells wine and offers personalized recommendations.
name: Vivino
subtitle: Wine recognition app with AI-driven recommendations

description: Wildbook, built by the nonprofit Wild Me, uses computer vision to match photos of fins, flukes, and skin patterns against a database of known individual animals. Researchers use it to track wildlife populations.
name: Wildbook

description: Yoodli records a practice interview or presentation, scores filler words, pacing, eye contact, and clarity, and suggests specific fixes. Career coaches and job seekers use it to rehearse answers.
name: Yoodli
subtitle: AI speech coach for interview practice and public speaking

description: Zycus covers the procurement cycle from sourcing through invoicing. Its AI assistant reads supplier contracts, flags pricing outside normal ranges, and recommends vendors for negotiation.
name: Zycus
subtitle: AI source-to-pay procurement platform

description: Dots are personal agents from OpenAI that run in the background on their own cloud computers and appear inside ChatGPT. They learn your preferences, connect to thousands of apps, and keep working toward your goals while you are away.
name: OpenAI Dots
subtitle: OpenAI's always-on personal agents that run on their own cloud computers

name: Cuey
subtitle: A browser extension that runs one prompt across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek at once

description: Mo is an agentic testing product from Momentic. Given an app's URL and test credentials, it sends agents to click buttons, fill in fields, and try edge cases the way a real user would, looking for bugs.

name: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform
subtitle: An open-source security layer that can quarantine a misbehaving AI agent within milliseconds
