name: QA Wolf
subtitle: Fully-managed AI test automation that gets engineering teams to 80% coverage in weeks

description: TypingMind is a chat interface that connects to OpenAI, Anthropic, and other model APIs with your own key, avoiding per-seat subscriptions. It adds features such as prompt libraries, plugins, and team sharing.
name: TypingMind
subtitle: A custom chat interface for GPT and Claude that runs on your own API key

description: ByteAsk is a startup that focuses on debugging, performance tuning, and maintenance of existing code instead of writing new features. Independent details are limited, so check its site for current features.
name: ByteAsk
subtitle: A coding agent built for debugging and optimizing C and C++ rather than generating new code

description: Ando is a Slack-style team messaging platform where AI agents are full participants. Agents can join channels, read context, message coworkers, and take actions, including agents built on Claude or Codex.
name: Ando
subtitle: Team chat where AI agents hold their own inboxes alongside human coworkers

description: Scholé gives professionals and teams personalized, task-based learning grounded in learning science, delivered inside their normal workflow instead of as separate courses.
name: Scholé
subtitle: Turns a person's actual work tasks into adaptive, in-flow learning modules

name: Lettu
subtitle: An AI platform from a UK law firm that handles deal paperwork for creators and talent managers

name: Claude Slides
subtitle: Anthropic's presentation builder for creating decks inside Claude

name: Enlive
subtitle: Free AI interface that turns casual requests into well-engineered prompts

description: Grok Bot is xAI's agent product. It turns Grok into autonomous agents that you hand multi-step work to, each running on its own cloud computer with a browser, files, and command line tools.
name: Grok Bot
subtitle: xAI's always-on AI teammates with their own cloud computer

description: MagicShot bundles more than eighty AI creation and editing tools, covering images, video, avatars, product photography, and voiceovers, in one workspace with a shared credit balance instead of separate subscriptions.
name: MagicShot
subtitle: All-in-one AI studio for images, video, and voice from a single credit pool

description: MosMos is a macOS voice workspace that adapts its output to the app you are dictating into and keeps a personal glossary so technical terms are not misheard. In meetings, it produces speaker-labeled notes.
name: MosMos
subtitle: A native Mac app that turns speech into formatted text in whatever app you are using

description: Sider Omni Sidebar is a macOS-wide AI agent from Sider, separate from its Chrome extension. It reads what is on screen in any app, such as documents, email, and spreadsheets, and helps with tasks.
name: Sider Omni Sidebar
subtitle: An AI sidebar that sits next to any Mac app and can act on whatever is on screen

description: CC is a Google Labs experiment built on Gemini. It sends a daily briefing to your inbox that summarizes your schedule, tasks, and updates from Gmail, Calendar, and Drive, and you can reply to it by email.
name: CC
subtitle: A Google Labs agent that coordinates shared calendars and errands for a household

name: Meta Muse
subtitle: Meta's personal AI agent that books, buys, and schedules for you

description: Free AI Face Swap is a browser tool from Facy.ai for swapping faces between two photos, with no sign-up for basic use. It handles common image formats and also offers video face swaps and other effects.
name: Free AI Face Swap
subtitle: Free browser-based tool for swapping faces in photos

name: MagiCrew

name: Aloud
subtitle: Turns spoken feedback into tasks for coding agents

name: Magic Hour

name: OpenCode
subtitle: Open-source, terminal-native coding agent that works with any model

description: QueryStory is a data platform built around AI agents that reason over an organization's data and business context. Instead of only producing dashboards, it answers questions and explains what changed and why.
name: QueryStory
subtitle: Agentic data platform for decision-ready recommendations

subtitle: AI employee that works inside Slack and Microsoft Teams

name: Daybreak

name: Cloudflare Kitesurf

description: Test Companion is BrowserStack's agentic AI for software testing, built to live inside the IDE. It writes and runs test scripts, debugs failing tests, and maintains them as an application changes.
name: BrowserStack Test Companion
subtitle: Agentic AI for software testing, built into the IDE

name: Comet

name: Genspark

name: Google Antigravity

description: Kiro is an agentic IDE from AWS that treats a written spec, not a chat prompt, as the unit of work. The agent plans a feature, writes the requirements and design, then implements, tests, and documents it.
name: Kiro
subtitle: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE

description: Presence is an enterprise platform from OpenAI for building and running AI agents that handle voice and chat conversations across customer support and internal workflows. It combines OpenAI's models with tools for deployment and oversight.
name: OpenAI Presence
subtitle: OpenAI's managed platform for enterprise voice and chat AI agents

name: Algolia AI Search

name: AMD ROCm

name: Braintrust

name: Cohere North

name: Dataiku
subtitle: Enterprise platform for building, governing, and scaling AI

name: DeepSeek

name: DeepSeek Chat

description: Elastic AI Assistant brings generative AI to Elastic's search, observability, and security products. It helps teams investigate alerts, query and summarize data, and get context-aware answers from information indexed in Elastic.
name: Elastic AI Assistant
subtitle: Generative AI assistant for search and security workflows

name: Figma Make

name: FLUX

name: Gemini Pro

name: Mistral

name: NVIDIA NIM

name: OpenVINO

name: Qualcomm AI Hub

name: Qwen Studio

name: Future Tools

name: Futurepedia

description: Muse Image is Meta's first in-house image generator from Meta Superintelligence Labs. It is built into the Meta AI app, Instagram Stories, and WhatsApp, with the model working through a prompt before producing an image.
name: Muse Image
subtitle: Meta's first in-house AI image generator, built by Superintelligence Labs

description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's image generation and editing model, available through Gemini and Google's AI tools. It is noted for fast, detailed output, strong text rendering, and editing from natural language instructions.

name: AI for Developers
subtitle: Practical AI for software developers

name: Altern Newsletter
subtitle: Weekly AI tools and discoveries, curated by the Altern team

name: Superhuman AI

name: SwiftAlerts

name: Anomaly AI

name: Igly

name: Submit AI Tools

name: ZOOOP

name: AIPRM

name: Alli AI

name: Amplemarket

description: Anyscale is the company behind Ray, the open-source framework for distributed computing in Python. Its platform runs and manages Ray workloads for training, fine-tuning, batch processing, and serving AI models at scale.
name: Anyscale

description: Arcade turns screen recordings into guided, clickable product walkthroughs. Marketing and sales teams use it to build demos that prospects can explore on their own, without a live call or a sandbox.
name: Arcade

description: Baseten is an inference platform for deploying AI models in production. ML teams use it to serve custom models, fine-tuned checkpoints, and open-source models like Llama with fast startup times and autoscaling.
name: Baseten

name: BentoML

description: Bloomfire centralizes company knowledge in a searchable hub. Teams use natural language search to find answers from documentation, past support tickets, and internal wikis, reducing repeated questions.
name: Bloomfire

description: C3.ai sells enterprise AI applications for industries such as energy, manufacturing, financial services, and government. Organizations deploy its prebuilt apps for predictive maintenance, fraud detection, and supply chain optimization.
name: C3.ai

name: Cal.com

description: ChurnZero is a customer success platform for subscription software companies. It tracks product usage, scores account health, predicts churn, and automates engagement, with AI features for summaries and next steps.
name: ChurnZero

description: Cognism is a B2B sales intelligence platform with verified contact data and buying intent signals. Sales teams use it to find decision-makers, with a focus on European data and phone-verified mobile numbers.
name: Cognism

description: ConvertKit, now called Kit, is an email marketing platform for creators such as writers, podcasters, and course sellers. It handles subscriber management, automated email sequences, landing pages, and selling digital products.
name: ConvertKit

description: Cutout.Pro is an AI image editing platform for background removal, photo retouching, and enhancement. Designers and e-commerce teams use it to batch-process product images without desktop software, and it offers an API.
name: Cutout.Pro

description: Databricks is a data and AI platform built on a lakehouse architecture. It combines data engineering, SQL analytics, machine learning, and governance, and offers tools for building AI agents on company data.
name: Databricks

description: DataStax is a data platform built around Astra DB, a managed database for vector search and real-time AI applications. It is based on Apache Cassandra, and IBM agreed to acquire the company.
name: DataStax

description: DeepInfra is a cloud inference platform for running open-source AI models through a simple API without managing GPUs. Developers call models such as Llama, Mistral, and Whisper at low cost, paying by usage.
name: DeepInfra

name: Eden AI

description: Enhancv is a resume builder that helps job seekers write stronger resumes using AI suggestions. It offers templates that read well in applicant tracking systems and prompts users to add measurable achievements.
name: Enhancv

name: Firecrawl

description: Gainsight is a customer success platform that scores account health, flags churn risk, and identifies expansion opportunities. Customer success teams manage their whole portfolio from one view and trigger plays automatically.
name: Gainsight

description: Gencraft is an AI image and video generation app for making art, avatars, and creative content on mobile and web. Creators generate images from text prompts, apply styles to photos, and produce short AI videos.
name: Gencraft

description: Genmo is an AI video generation company and the team behind Mochi 1, an open-source video model known for fluid motion. Researchers and creators can run Mochi locally from the open weights or use its hosted service.
name: Genmo

description: GetResponse is an email marketing and automation platform that includes campaigns, landing pages, webinars, and list building. Small businesses use it for automated sequences and newsletters, with AI tools to speed up creation.
name: GetResponse

description: Glassbox is a digital experience analytics platform that records session replays and creates heatmaps to show how users behave on websites and apps. Product and UX teams use it to find friction and drop-offs.
name: Glassbox

description: Haystack is an open-source Python framework from deepset for building search and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines in production. It connects retrievers, language models, and data sources into applications.
name: Haystack

description: Hex is a collaborative data workspace where analysts and data scientists build notebooks, dashboards, and data apps in a shared environment. Its AI agents help write SQL and Python and answer questions from data.
name: Hex

description: Higgsfield AI is a video generation platform that gives users more control over footage than most competitors. You specify camera movements, character behavior, and cinematic style rather than relying only on a prompt.
name: Higgsfield AI

description: Highspot is a sales enablement platform where revenue teams manage content, train reps, and get guidance through sales motions. Analytics show which content helps win deals.
name: Highspot

description: Hocoos is an AI website builder that creates a publish-ready site from a few questions about your business. Small business owners use it to get a site with generated copy, images, and a store or booking tools.
name: Hocoos

description: Hour One turns scripts into presenter-led videos using realistic virtual humans. Learning and development teams, marketers, and creators use it for training videos, product explainers, and marketing content.
name: Hour One

description: Huntr is a job search tracker that organizes applications on a Kanban-style board with stages from wishlist to offer. Job seekers use it to track applications, interviews, and follow-ups in one place.
name: Huntr

description: Instapage is a landing page platform for building, testing, and personalizing post-click experiences for paid campaigns. Marketing teams create dedicated pages without developer help and improve conversions with A/B tests.
name: Instapage

description: Jobscan compares your resume with a specific job description and scores how well they match for applicant tracking systems. Job seekers use it to find missing keywords and skills before applying.
name: Jobscan

description: Kaspr is a LinkedIn prospecting tool that surfaces verified phone numbers and email addresses for contacts you find on the platform. Sales teams use its Chrome extension to pull contact details into their CRM.
name: Kaspr

description: Keyword Insights is an AI keyword research and content clustering tool that groups keywords by search intent and topic. SEO teams use it to plan content around topical authority.
name: Keyword Insights

description: Kommunicate is an AI chatbot and live chat platform that automates customer support with smooth handoff to human agents. Support teams build no-code chatbots that handle common questions.
name: Kommunicate

description: Landbot is a no-code chatbot builder for creating conversational flows on websites, WhatsApp, and landing pages. Marketing and customer success teams use it to collect leads, qualify visitors, and route inquiries.
name: Landbot

description: Laxis is an AI meeting assistant that transcribes, summarizes, and extracts insights from sales calls, interviews, and client meetings. Teams use it to capture what was discussed without taking notes.
name: Laxis

description: Let's Enhance is an AI image upscaling tool that increases photo resolution while preserving and sharpening detail. Photographers, e-commerce teams, and print designers use it to enlarge low-resolution images.
name: Let's Enhance

name: Letta

description: Lifesum is a nutrition and diet tracking app with calorie logging, macro tracking, and personalized meal plans. Users log meals by searching a food database or scanning barcodes, and the app adapts goals to their needs.
name: Lifesum

description: Lindy is a no-code platform for building AI assistants, called Lindies, that automate work across the tools you already use. Teams build Lindies to triage email, schedule meetings, research prospects, and handle follow-ups.
name: Lindy

description: Lusha is a B2B sales intelligence tool for finding verified phone numbers, email addresses, and company data. Sales reps use its browser extension to pull contact details directly from LinkedIn.
name: Lusha

name: Magic Patterns

name: Mailchimp

description: MailerLite is an email marketing platform for campaigns, automations, landing pages, and newsletters. Small businesses and creators use it for a simple interface and a generous free plan.
name: MailerLite

name: ManyChat

name: Marketinguys
subtitle: Discover and connect with top marketers and creative agencies

description: memoQ is a computer-assisted translation tool and translation management system for professional translators, language service providers, and in-house localization teams. It combines translation memory, terminology, and machine translation.
name: memoQ

description: MiniMax is a Chinese AI company with video generation, image generation, speech, and multimodal foundation models, offered through a consumer app and developer APIs. Its Hailuo video model competes with Kling and others.
name: Minimax

name: MLflow

name: Moonvalley

name: Navattic

name: Planable

name: Prome AI

name: Promptfoo

name: Ragas

name: Rewatch

name: Seamless AI

description: Seismic is a sales enablement platform for enterprise revenue teams. It surfaces relevant content for each deal, tracks what prospects engage with, and uses AI to personalize materials and guide sellers.
name: Seismic

description: Showpad is a sales enablement platform that combines content management, rep training, and AI coaching. Revenue teams use it to help reps present the right material and practice skills.
name: Showpad

description: Smartling is a translation management platform that combines neural machine translation with human review workflows for localizing digital content. Marketing and product teams use it to publish in many languages.
name: Smartling

name: Snowflake

description: Soundful generates royalty-free background music for videos, podcasts, and other content using AI. Creators choose a genre and mood, and the platform produces unique tracks they can use commercially.
name: Soundful

description: Sprinklr is a unified customer experience platform that brings social media management, customer support, marketing, and market intelligence into one system for enterprise brands.
name: Sprinklr

description: Stack AI is a no-code platform for building AI workflows and automations in enterprise settings. Operations, support, and IT teams create pipelines that process documents, answer questions, and take actions.
name: Stack AI

description: Stockcake is a free library of AI-generated stock photos across categories such as food, travel, business, and lifestyle. Creators and marketers use it to find royalty-free images.
name: Stockcake

description: Supademo generates interactive product walkthroughs from screen recordings and adds AI voiceovers. Marketing and sales teams use it to share guided product experiences that prospects can click through.
name: Supademo

description: Sylvera is a platform that rates and analyzes carbon credits to help organizations evaluate the quality of climate investments. Corporate sustainability teams and investors use its ratings and data.
name: Sylvera

description: SYSTRAN is a neural machine translation platform for enterprises that need translation deployed on premises or in the cloud. Defense, legal, and financial organizations use it for secure translation.
name: SYSTRAN

description: Talkwalker is a social listening and consumer intelligence platform that tracks brand mentions, competitor activity, and emerging trends across social media, news, blogs, and podcasts. Hootsuite acquired it.
name: Talkwalker

description: Teal is a job search platform combining an application tracker, AI resume builder, and job matching. Job seekers keep every application in one place and tailor their resumes for each role.
name: Teal

description: Totango is a customer success platform with a modular structure that lets teams assemble workflows from reusable components. Customer success managers use it to track health, automate engagement, and manage renewals.

description: Hatchful is Shopify's free logo maker. No subscription, no watermarks, no paid upgrade to unlock the good stuff. Anyone can use it, download the files, and walk away without entering a credit card. The whole thing takes under five minutes. You pick where the logo will be used (online store, social media, print), choose an industry, select a handful of style directions like bold, minimalistic, or hipster, type in your business name and an optional slogan, and then browse generated options. Hatchful has over 13,000 design combinations across 17 style categories. Once you land on something close, a basic editor lets you tweak fonts, colours, and layout before downloading. What you get in the zip: a standard logo, a transparent background version, a favicon, and pre-sized files for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Twitter, and YouTube. All PNGs. That last part matters, because Hatchful does not export SVG or any vector format. If you later need the logo on a banner, a sign, or embroidered on a jacket, you will have to either recreate it in a vector tool or pay someone to trace it. That limitation tells you who this is actually for. A sole trader testing a business idea, or a Shopify store owner who needs something on the page before launch day, will get through fine. Someone building a brand they plan to use at scale, across print and merchandise and packaging, will eventually hit the wall.
name: Hatchful
subtitle: Free logo maker by Shopify for small businesses and entrepreneurs
